# LLMCSS: The Human-Craft UI Framework for Agents & Humans
> An open, modern UI system engineered specifically for AI agents and human developers to build clean, tactile, non-cookie-cutter interfaces with zero AI slop.

## Quickstart
- Humans: https://llmcss.io/quickstart
- Repo: https://github.com/maku-au/llmcss/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md
- Stylesheet: https://llmcss.io/llmcss.css
- `npx llmcss add btn-variants`

## Quick Facts
- **Pure Native CSS**: Zero build steps, zero Tailwind runtime dependencies, uses `@layer` (reset, tokens, base, components, utilities).
- **Design Direction Harness**: 4 curated archetypes and 10 deterministic anti-slop laws to ensure autonomous agents generate human-craft interfaces.
- **Modern Responsive Engine**: Native Container Queries (`.ai-cq`, `@container`) and intrinsic auto-fit grids (`.ai-grid-auto-fit`) eliminate media query bloat.
- **Hardware-Accelerated Motion**: Pure CSS spinners, indeterminate progress bars, tactile sliders, shimmer skeletons, with strict `prefers-reduced-motion` compliance.
- **Dual-Mode**: Standard semantic HTML with `data-ai-*` attributes or Light-DOM custom elements (`<ai-modal>`, `<ai-tabs>`, `<ai-dropdown>`, etc.).
- **Curated Archetypes**: Theme skins via `[data-ai-skin="executive|fintech|obsidian|editorial|enterprise|emerald|violet|rose"]`.
- **Focus ring**: tokens `--ai-focus-color`, `--ai-focus-width`, `--ai-focus-offset`, `--ai-tap-highlight`. Presets on `<html>`: `data-ai-focus="neutral|thin|none"`. Rings only appear for `:focus-visible` (keyboard), never on tap.
- **Monetization**: Free open-source primitives and starter sections (MIT); Pro catalog for advanced bento, SaaS dashboards, and e-commerce flows.

## The 4 Design Direction Archetypes
1. **Executive Slate** (`data-ai-skin="executive"`): High-density data workspace, cool slate neutrals, 4px architectural radius, tabular numerals.
2. **Fintech Titanium** (`data-ai-skin="fintech"`): Institutional clarity, warm titanium stone neutrals, 6px radius, emerald and teal accents, generous whitespace.
3. **Obsidian Minimal** (`data-ai-skin="obsidian"`): Pure monochrome precision, pitch-black background (#000000), stark white accents, 0px-2px sharp radii.
4. **Editorial Atelier** (`data-ai-skin="editorial"`): Typographic publishing aesthetic, warm paper substrate, serif display headlines, crisp hairline borders.

## The 10 Anti-Slop Laws for AI Agents
1. **Never Nest Cards**: Flatten hierarchy with whitespace (`--ai-space-6`) or subtle hairline rules (`.ai-divider`).
2. **Never Pulse Static Dots**: Steady jewel pips (`.ai-status-pip`) for static states; reserve `.is-streaming` strictly for live telemetry.
3. **Never Use Thick Left Stripes**: Uniform 1px architectural borders with a 6px status jewel pip.
4. **Never Use Electric Purple Gradients**: Multi-stop physical elevation shadows on solid neutral surfaces.
5. **Never Stamp Monospace Eyebrows**: Lead directly with clear, confident headlines.
6. **Never Crush Letter-Spacing**: Body tracking at 0; negative tracking only on display titles (`-0.02em` to `-0.035em`).
7. **Never Use Low-Contrast Text**: WCAG AA compliant contrast on all surfaces and states.
8. **Never Create Identical KPI Grids**: Anchor a dominant metric with supporting secondary metrics.
9. **Never Auto-Scroll Marquees**: Clean, static, scannable badge rails and grids.
10. **Always Theme Browser Surfaces**: Caret color, custom scrollbars, selection, and tabular numerals.

## Wireframe Section Templates & Page Blueprints
- **18 Composable Section Templates**: Header (`wireframe-nav-minimal`, `wireframe-nav-banner`, `wireframe-docs-header`), Hero (`wireframe-hero-split`, `wireframe-hero-centered`, `wireframe-hero-editorial`), Social Proof (`wireframe-social-proof-bar`, `wireframe-quote-band`), Features (`wireframe-features-bento`, `wireframe-features-alternating`, `wireframe-changelog`), Comparison (`wireframe-comparison-matrix`), Pricing (`wireframe-pricing-tiers`), FAQ (`wireframe-faq-accordion`), CTA (`wireframe-cta-card`), Footer (`wireframe-footer-columns`), App Shell (`wireframe-app-shell`, `wireframe-dash-header`).
- **4 Full-Page Blueprints / Recipes**:
  1. `saas-landing`: Nav -> Split Hero -> Social Proof Rail -> Bento Features -> Pricing Tiers -> FAQ -> CTA -> Footer.
  2. `developer-tool`: Banner Nav -> Centered Hero -> Social Proof Rail -> Alternating Features -> Comparison Matrix -> CTA -> Footer.
  3. `editorial-manifesto`: Minimal Nav -> Editorial Hero -> Social Proof Rail -> Bento Features -> FAQ -> CTA -> Footer.
  4. `dashboard-shell`: Full Application Viewport Shell with Sidebar, Topbar, Metric Row, and Data Canvas.
- **CLI Commands**:
  - `npx llmcss templates`: List all 18 section templates with placement guidance.
  - `npx llmcss template get <id>`: Output clean semantic HTML for a section.
  - `npx llmcss template blueprints`: List full-page composition recipes.
  - `npx llmcss template blueprint <name>`: Assemble and output full-page HTML.
- **MCP Server Tools**: `list_wireframe_templates`, `get_wireframe_template`, `get_page_blueprint`.
- **Templates Registry JSON**: https://llmcss.io/templates.json

## Agent Tooling & Verification
- CLI Design Harness: `npx llmcss harness [executive|fintech|obsidian|editorial]`
- CLI Design Quality Audit: `npx llmcss audit <file>` (validates against all 10 anti-slop rules)
- CLI Linter and Validator: `npx llmcss validate <file>` and `npx llmcss lint --fix <file>` (auto-migrates non-prefixed classes)
- CLI Component Installer: `npx llmcss add <component-id>`
- CLI Template Extractor: `npx llmcss template get <id>` and `npx llmcss template blueprint <name>`
- Stdio MCP Server: `npx llmcss-mcp` (exposes `llmcss_get_harness`, `llmcss_slop_audit`, `search_components`, `get_component_markup`, `validate_markup`, `list_tokens`, `list_wireframe_templates`, `get_wireframe_template`, `get_page_blueprint`)
- Registry Index: https://llmcss.io/registry.json
- Per-component (free): https://llmcss.io/r/{id}.json
- Templates Index: https://llmcss.io/templates.json
- Full Agent Specification & Code Patterns: https://llmcss.io/llms-full.txt
- Agent rules: https://github.com/maku-au/llmcss/blob/main/AGENTS.md
